summary: First iteration - full backend + frontend testing for PaintOps Daily. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed (auth, admin users, weather, visits, breaks, sms-logs, reports with AI summary + Resend email, workday CSV export, role-based visibility). Frontend: E2E mobile flow completed end-to-end - login as admin, home weather widget + quick actions, Map tab visit creation, break start via modal, SMS log entry, report composition with AI summary rendered (confirmed 'Sent to: delivered@resend.dev' visible in report detail), admin user creation via Profile > Manage Users, and sign out. AI summary generation via GPT-5.4 (Emergent LLM key) and Resend email delivery both verified working end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: After starting a break via break-modal and navigating back to Home, the active-break-banner and end-break-button do not appear immediately - loadEverything() is not re-run on focus. Consider using useFocusEffect from expo-router or a refresh trigger so home reloads breaks/visits when user returns from a modal.

action_items: Fix state refresh: home tab (app/(tabs)/index.tsx) should re-run loadEverything() when regaining focus after break-modal / sms-log / report navigation. Use useFocusEffect from @react-navigation/native (or expo-router equivalent).
Optional: add testID to Text elements showing AI summary content in report/[id].tsx (e.g. 'report-ai-summary') for stronger E2E assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 823-line file - as features grow, consider splitting into routers (auth.py, admin.py, reports.py, visits.py, breaks.py, sms.py, weather.py) for maintainability.
server.py hardcodes EMAIL_BASE_URL='https://integrations.emergentagent.com' - acceptable for Emergent integration but consider making it env-configurable.
test_credentials.md is empty - populate with the seeded admin credentials for future testing agents.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds admin@paintops.com on startup. Tests created a Production user (production@paintops.com / Prod@12345), one visit, one Admin Call break, one SMS log, and one daily report (with delivered@resend.dev recipient). Frontend UI test additionally created a Labor user 'uitest_<ts>@paintops.com'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://project-digest-7.preview.emergentagent.com). Admin: admin@paintops.com / Admin@12345 (auto-seeded). Run pytest with `-n 0` to bypass xdist parallel mode which breaks module-scoped state fixture. Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. AI summary endpoint /api/reports takes ~10-15s. Email delivery to delivered@resend.dev is verified via email_sent_to list in report response.
rca_of_issue: Active break banner not appearing on Home right after break-modal creation. RCA: app/(tabs)/index.tsx runs loadEverything() only inside useEffect on mount; when user opens the modal (still same route) and returns, the effect does not re-fire. Fix: use useFocusEffect(useCallback(()=>{loadEverything();},[])) so state syncs whenever tab regains focus.
